catalysts.name: Bellows
catalysts.text: Reactions involving an Ore score double.

catalysts.name: Bestiary
catalysts.text: Reactions involving a Beast part score double.

catalysts.name: Heart Tile
catalysts.text: Reactions touching the centre tile score double.

catalysts.name: First Spark
catalysts.text: The first reaction of each trial scores triple.

catalysts.name: Crooked Mirror
catalysts.text: Diagonal neighbours also react.

catalysts.name: Hourglass
catalysts.text: One more trial at every depth.

catalysts.name: Deep Satchel
catalysts.text: Draw one more material each trial.

catalysts.name: Eureka Lens
catalysts.text: New discoveries score triple.

catalysts.name: Resonant Slab
catalysts.text: Chains build faster: each reaction counts one step higher.

catalysts.name: Quiet Bench
catalysts.text: Each reaction gains 20 potency per empty tile.

catalysts.name: Herbarium
catalysts.text: Reactions involving a Plant score double.

catalysts.name: Alembic
catalysts.text: Reactions involving a Potion score double.

catalysts.name: Wide Crucible
catalysts.text: Reactions of three or more materials score half again.

catalysts.name: Quick Hands
catalysts.text: Reactions of two materials score half again.

catalysts.name: Grain of Gold
catalysts.text: Every reaction gains 30 potency.

catalysts.name: Tier Seeker
catalysts.text: Reactions that make a tier 3 or higher result score double.

catalysts.name: Hearth Habit
catalysts.text: Reactions using two or more starting materials score double.

catalysts.name: Second Wind
catalysts.text: One more redraw at every depth.

catalysts.name: Warm Bench
catalysts.text: Every material counts one more Reaction Index for the heat round a hub.

catalysts.name: Salvage
catalysts.text: Discoveries left standing on the bench after a chain go back to the rack.

catalysts.name: Cascade
catalysts.text: Reactions from the third in a chain on score double.

catalysts.name: Descent
catalysts.text: Reactions score a quarter more for each depth below the first.

catalysts.name: Tinker's Eye
catalysts.text: The first new discovery at each depth costs no trial.

catalysts.name: Bottomless Satchel
catalysts.text: Draw two more materials each trial.

catalysts.name: Philosopher's Fire
catalysts.text: Every reaction scores double.

catalysts.name: Last Breath
catalysts.text: Once per run, a lost depth gives two more trials.

aspects.name: Doubled Tile
aspects.text: A reaction whose hub is on this tile scores double.

aspects.name: Anchor Tile
aspects.text: A discovery placed here comes back to the rack after the Ignite.

aspects.name: Heated Tile
aspects.text: A material on this tile counts 3 more Reaction Index.

aspects.name: Echo Tile
aspects.text: What a hub on this tile makes also goes to the rack as a copy.

aspects.name: Attuned Tile
aspects.text: A hub here whose recipe uses the attuned kind scores as one tier higher.

aspects.name: Seed Tile
aspects.text: Left empty, it gives 40 potency to every reaction whose hub touches it.

aspects.name: Fallow Tile
aspects.text: Left empty at Ignite, it draws you one more material.

aspects.name: Heavy Tile
aspects.text: A reaction whose hub is on this tile counts one chain step higher.

aspects.name: Cold Tile
aspects.text: One more trial at every depth. COST: this tile is shut for the run.

aspects.name: Volatile Tile
aspects.text: A hub here scores triple. COST: a starting material placed here is lost for the run.

aspects.name: Greedy Bench
aspects.text: Draw one more material each trial. COST: one redraw fewer at every depth.

aspects.name: Bridge
aspects.text: Two tiles that do not touch count as neighbours.

aspects.name: Open Bench
aspects.text: A corner tile also touches the centre tile.

aspects.name: Kiln Tile
aspects.text: A hub on this tile needs no heat: its recipe fires in any company.

aspects.name: Crossroads
aspects.text: A hub on this tile also reaches its diagonal neighbours.

aspects.name: Pivot Tile
aspects.text: If the material here can react, it goes first whatever its Reaction Index.

events.name: A Keepers' Altar
events.text: A cracked altar to the Keepers asks for an offering.

outcomes.text: The altar drinks it in. Time slows.

events.name: An Old Workbench
events.text: Another Keeper's bench. Tilted, but roomy.

events.name: A Keeper's Ledger
events.text: A damp ledger lists what another Keeper tried.

events.name: A Keeper's Furnace
events.text: An old furnace gapes, still warm after all this time.

events.name: A Dripping Well
events.text: Something glints at the bottom of a dripping well.

outcomes.text: Your hand closes on a moment saved.
Something slips from your satchel into the dark.

events.name: A Shifting Bench
events.text: Roots shift under the floor. The bench grinds.

outcomes.text: A tile settles over a warm root.

events.name: A Buried Crate
events.text: A crate, half swallowed by the roots.

outcomes.text: It spills grit across the bench.

events.name: A Forgotten Satchel
events.text: A satchel like yours, left on the stair.

events.name: A Glinting Seam
events.text: An old brew has set into the wall like ore.

events.name: A Sealed Shrine
events.text: A shrine to the first Keeper hums at your catalysts.

events.name: A Quiet Shrine
events.text: A quiet shrine. It has all the time you can give it.

outcomes.text: Something is left in your hands.

events.name: Damp Air
events.text: Water seeps down from the stair. Everything cools.

events.name: Falling Grit
events.text: Grit falls from the roots onto the bench.

events.name: A Cold Draft
events.text: A cold draft comes up the stair, through your pockets.

events.name: A Warm Stone
events.text: A stone in the wall is warm. Something grows behind it.

outcomes.text: The warmth spreads into one tile.

events.name: A Keeper's Room
events.text: A cot, a cup, a name scratched out. Dust turns slowly.

outcomes.text: Nothing happens, and that is welcome.

events.name: Names in the Wall
events.text: Names cut into the wall, one under another.

outcomes.text: The last one is fresh. There is room below it.

events.name: Warm Roots
events.text: Roots push through the ceiling. They are warm, and hum.

outcomes.text: You feel the hum in your teeth.

events.name: A Pinned Note
events.text: A note pinned to a bench: 'Plant it. Do not climb back.'
